name: Chicken Karahi
ingredients_with_quantities: Chicken 1 kg (cut into pieces); Ginger garlic paste 2 tbsp; Oil 1/2 cup; Salt 1.5 tsp; Tomatoes 500 g (chopped); Green chillies 4; Red chilli powder 1 tsp; Coriander powder 1 tsp; Cumin seeds 1/2 tsp
steps: Heat the oil in a karahi on high heat|Add the ginger garlic paste and the chicken and fry on high heat for 6 to 8 minutes until the chicken changes colour|Add the tomatoes, green chillies, salt and all the spices|Cover and cook on medium heat for 20 minutes until the chicken is tender, adding a splash of water if it dries out|Cook uncovered on high heat until the oil separates and the gravy is thick|Garnish with ginger strips and fresh coriander

steps: Heat the oil in a pot and fry the sliced onions until golden brown|Add the ginger garlic paste and the mutton and fry on high heat for 10 minutes until browned|Add 2 chopped tomatoes, salt, chilli, turmeric and coriander powder and fry until the oil separates|Add 1 cup of water, cover and cook on low heat for 70 minutes (or pressure cook for 25 minutes) until the meat is tender|Add the chana daal and cook for 30 minutes until it is tender|Simmer until the gravy thickens and garnish with fresh coriander and green chillies
